PerceptionBench: Evaluating Atomic Visual Perception in Multimodal Large Language Models
   


	
		
	
	
		Abstract
	

We introduce PerceptionBench, a benchmark specifically designed to evaluate the atomic visual perception capabilities of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs).
